name: Beszel
description: A monitoring hub for a fleet of machines: CPU, memory, disk, network and per-container history with alerts, collected by a small agent you install on each machine you want to watch. This deployment is the hub only; it keeps its history in SQLite on the data volume and needs no scrape configuration.

access.note: Beszel ships with no accounts and no default password. The first visitor is shown a Create-account form in place of the sign-in form, and the account it creates is the admin that owns the hub; the form then disappears and only that admin can add anyone else. Open the address the moment the deploy finishes — whoever reaches it first owns it. The hub is empty until you install the Beszel agent on a machine and add that machine here; the agent is a separate per-host install, not part of this deployment.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: The address you and your agents reach the hub at. Beszel writes it into the links in alert e-mails and push notifications, so it is required rather than cosmetic.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The dashboard, the API and the agent connections

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The metric history, the systems, the alert rules and the hub's own SSH key

update.notes: Beszel runs its database migrations on start and keeps the key pair your agents already trust, so existing agents reconnect without being re-added. Back the data volume up first: the migrations are one-way.
